reason: Version 5 preserves every goal, metric, caveat, and non-goal with only light synonyms, aside from recasting consequences as “costs.” Version 2 stays nearly verbatim but adds that the system handles routine reassignments; 4 intensifies client impact (“hurt”) and drops the significance framing; 1 shifts definitions (lives nearby, passed vs. escalated, testing realism vs. validating the target); 3 omits secondary goals and non-goals and changes metric definitions and commitments.
